description: Summarises a country for moving abroad: tax system (residence-based, territorial, no income tax, remittance basis or citizenship-based), the residency and citizenship by investment programmes of the index in that country with their programme pages, and the GoodbyeMatrix climate map, plus the date of the source and consultationNote. Covers about 200 countries. Read-only: it only retrieves and computes from the GoodbyeMatrix data set, stores nothing, sends nothing and calls no external services.

country.description: Country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (for example "PA") or name in English or German.
